document.abstract: An intelligence robot camera system for broadcast use has been developed which automatically follows moving object in the picture. The video output signals from this camera is processed to generate movement data required to the pan and tilt head and the lens servo system. This landmark system's feature is real time following operation and any desirable camera shot is available at anytime.
